original_test_intent: Verify that the BMC's mDNS/DNS-SD service is intentionally confined to the platform interface identified as eth0 and neither listens, joins multicast nor advertises services on any other enabled management or internal interface.
original_method: Select the unique row; identify BMC firmware/OS and the physical/logical mapping of eth0; use protected console access; inventory all interfaces; capture Avahi unit journal for the relevant boot and service instance; read the effective daemon configuration, service status and sockets/interface memberships; normalize renamed/virtual interfaces; compare every active binding or advertisement with the approved eth0-only policy; retain raw evidence without restart or configuration change.
manual_activity: Engineering supplies the eth0-to-physical-port mapping and accepted Avahi configuration/runtime policy; evidence collection and exclusivity evaluation are read-only and automatable.
required_inputs: BMC model, firmware/OS build and boot/session identity
Authoritative eth0 physical role plus all other interface/bridge/VLAN names and allowed exceptions
Avahi unit/configuration locations, supported journal window and runtime listener/advertisement oracle
Protected console credentials, trusted host identity and required command privileges
safety_requirements: Verify the intended BMC and authoritative interface map before evaluating names
Use only read-only journal, configuration, status, socket and link inspection
Preserve complete relevant journal range rather than an unbounded or truncated grep
Do not restart Avahi, edit configuration, flap interfaces, inject advertisements or clear logs
Stop on wrong BMC, ambiguous interface aliases, incomplete runtime evidence or command/permission error
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete Avahi journal entries for the approved boot/time range
Read effective configuration, service state, sockets/multicast memberships and all interfaces
Resolve each observed bind/listener/advertisement to the approved physical interface map
Do not alter daemon/network state, accept absence of grep hits as proof, expose secrets or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the eth0 physical/logical mapping and any bridge/VLAN/loopback exceptions
Approve which Avahi config, socket and journal signals prove exclusive operation
Review non-eth0 or indeterminate activity and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The journal grep matches the source trace and is read-only, but sshpass/disabled host verification is unsafe, journal scope is undefined and messages alone do not prove current exclusive binding.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: On the verified BMC over trusted access, capture scoped Avahi unit logs plus effective config, unit status, listener/multicast membership and `ip -br link/address`; parse every referenced active interface against the approved eth0 map.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC SSH/console context, Avahi journal check, eth0-only requirement, Common scope and 5/5-minute estimate remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate effective allow/deny configuration, current service bindings, multicast sockets and boot-scoped journal events with the complete BMC interface inventory, requiring every active path to resolve to approved eth0.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds time/boot scoping, authoritative interface identity, effective configuration and runtime socket evidence beyond text grep.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A journal containing only eth0 messages may omit silent listeners or prior/current activity on another interface; an empty grep may simply mean logs were rotated or the service did not start.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Avahi can bind through bridge, VLAN or renamed interfaces whose kernel names differ from board documentation, so aliases and allowed loopback behavior must be explicitly mapped.

project_override_considerations: If this firmware intentionally represents the external management port as a bridge/VLAN above eth0, engineering must approve the logical membership rule rather than require a literal string match. Disabled or absent Avahi must not automatically pass a functionality requirement unless policy explicitly allows it.
expected_evidence: BMC firmware/OS/boot ID and authoritative full interface/port map
Complete scoped Avahi journal output and command exits
Effective Avahi configuration and service status
Listener/multicast/advertisement interfaces with resolved physical roles
Explicit non-eth0 finding or exception evaluation

review_improvement: Preserves the source journal check while adding the runtime and topology evidence needed to prove exclusive eth0 behavior without changing Avahi or networking.
independent_technical_reasoning: Journal text is historical and may be incomplete; it records events, not necessarily all current sockets or advertisements. Conversely, no matching line may mean log rotation or a stopped service rather than correct confinement. The acceptance property is interface exclusivity, so effective daemon configuration and current multicast/listener state must be resolved against the actual BMC network topology. All required observations are read-only and deterministic once the project defines whether bridges or VLANs above eth0 count as the same allowed path.
